h1r.text: Sylvene comes from Ravnica to the Sword Coast decades ago, falls in love and builds a refuge for them in a small demiplane of her own creation.

She adventures on the Sword Coast, where a grand crypt is built in a verdant land to commemorate her allies and she hides valuable treasures in it, and eventually she returns to Ravnica with her young son and never comes back.
Now her grandson seeks to recover relics of her power by exploring her history in the Realms, and he harms others along the way.
